audit.why: Swain's Ravenous Flock (P) heals him off chip damage and Death's Hand (Q) out-ranges melee Poppy before level 2; Nevermove (E) unlocks at 2 and roots for a combo; Vision of Empire (W) adds a 22s-CD poke/reveal tool at 3; the heal keeps scaling through 4-5; Demonic Ascension (R) at 6 out-sustains any all-in; health-stacking items keep widening the gap until Poppy's own items/W/E come online.
audit.corrected: See paired edits below — side resolved to the real winner per row, why rewritten to name the actual interaction.

edits.before: Q the contacts — the hammer chunk is honest and the passive shield toss annoys.
edits.after: Death's Hand pokes and Ravenous Flock heals it — melee Poppy eats free damage.

edits.before: W governs dashes already — their mobility kit just lost its lane privileges.
edits.after: Nevermove unlocks at 2 and roots a full combo — one landed root swings it.

edits.after: Vision of Empire adds ranged poke and reveals — full kit, Swain out-ranges you.

edits.after: Ravenous Flock heals scale with rank — trades keep paying Swain back.

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict online — the dive that survives everything still flies home.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension's aura outheals your all-in — a close fight favors him.

edits.before: First item: the pins chunk and the W deletes engage comps.
edits.after: Health-stacking widens the DoT gap before your E can close.

edits.before: - Swain Nevermove: matchup-defining — The root that decides — dodge it and the general farms regret. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Steadfast Presence banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Swain Nevermove (E): 12s cooldown at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — dodge it, a landed root eats your full combo. - Vision of Empire (W) is a 22s CD poke tool; punish it once spent. - Demonic Ascension (R) is a 120s heal-aura fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: E him into a wall the moment Nevermove is down — Ravenous Flock still heals, so close the gap fast.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Trading chip while Nevermove is up — a landed root is a free combo his passive drain repays.
